server.note: Started from D:/personal/Photo/composition with 'npm run dev -- --port 5173 --strictPort'. Vite announced http://localhost:5173/, which is the resolved base_url. Stopped with TaskStop and 'doctor.mjs stop' (free_after: true). Driven with the Playwright MCP Chromium at 1280x800; AC-2.14 used a CDP iPhone 13 emulation (390x664, DPR 3, touch, iPhone UA), and the page was closed after it to drop the emulation.

preconditions.what: Phase 2 introduced: zoom-slider of cell-1-0 (port-1.jpg on template full) has min about 0.168 (not 1) and step="any"

assertions.then: while the zoom goes under 1, the cell shows the album background colour at the left and the right of the photo
assertions.actual: 11 wheel samples under 1; at every one, elementFromPoint in both bands hits the cell (transparent), and the first painted ancestor is spread-view rgb(244, 239, 230) = settings.background #f4efe6

assertions.then: the img box stays inside the cell box horizontally
assertions.actual: every sample has left >= 0 and right <= 1 (first 0.1106..0.8894, last 0.4158..0.5841)

assertions.then: at the end, the img height is half of the cell height, within 2 %
assertions.actual: hFrac = 0.5000

assertions.then: the zoom in the store is about 0.168
assertions.actual: 0.1683168316831683; three more wheel turns did not change it

assertions.then: the photo moves with the drag
assertions.actual: img left 0.4158 -> 0.3158 -> 0.2158 -> 0.1158 on the first left-drag steps; 0.1 -> 0.2 -> 0.3 on the right drag

assertions.then: after the drag to the left, the left edge of the img is at the left edge of the cell
assertions.actual: left = 0, right = 0.1683

assertions.then: after the drag to the right, the right edge of the img is at the right edge of the cell
at no time does the cell edge cut the img
assertions.actual: 20 samples during both drags; 0 with left < 0, right > 1, top < 0 or bottom > 1 (min left 0, max right 0.99998)

assertions.then: given: zoom of about 0.6, set with one mouse.wheel(0, 255)
assertions.actual: one mouse.wheel(0, 255) gave zoom 0.5286 (img 1.570 x cell height), which is between the whole-photo zoom 0.337 and 1, so the vertical axis is covered as the check needs

assertions.then: the img always covers the cell from its top edge to its bottom edge
assertions.actual: 20 samples during a drag of 2x cell height up and 2x down: max top 0, min bottom 1.0000; after up: top -0.570, bottom 1.000; after down: top 0, bottom 1.570

assertions.then: no band of background shows at the top or the bottom
assertions.actual: no sample had a top or bottom band

assertions.then: the img box relative to preview-cell-0 has the same left, top, width and height fractions as in the editor, within 1 %
assertions.actual: crop cx -0.219, cy 0.692, zoom 0.2231 (off the centre on both axes). Editor left 0.54885 top 0.04150 right 0.77198 bottom 0.70433; preview left 0.54886 top 0.04150 right 0.77199 bottom 0.70431; max abs difference 0.00002

assertions.then: a pixel in the wider of the two bands beside the photo is close to #1d1d1d
assertions.actual: background setting #1d1d1d; spreads/spread-01.jpg (7157x3614) left band pixel rgb(29, 29, 29), delta 0

assertions.then: a pixel at the centre of the photo is not the background colour
assertions.actual: rgb(202, 119, 77), sum of deltas 311

assertions.then: the photo's left and right edges are at the same fractions of the cell as in the editor, within 1 %
at zoom 1, low-dpi-1-0 shows 74 or 75 dpi
assertions.actual: '⚠ 75 dpi' at zoom 1 (land-1.jpg on full)

assertions.then: at the lower limit, low-dpi-1-0 shows 198 or 199 dpi
assertions.actual: '⚠ 199 dpi' at zoom 0.3787 (the wheel stopped there), in crop mode and after Escape

assertions.then: the zoom in the store goes under 1
assertions.actual: CDP Emulation.setTouchEmulationEnabled + Input.dispatchTouchEvent with two points, 600 px -> 120 px apart: zoom 1 -> 0.9655 -> ... -> 0.2069

assertions.then: the photo gets smaller and shows background bands at the left and the right
assertions.actual: img 0.3965..0.6034 of the cell width, both bands hit the cell; still in crop mode

assertions.then: after the wheel series, the zoom in the store is under 1
assertions.actual: 4 turns of deltaY 100 at 31, 65, 98, 130 ms: zoom 0.36788 (= e^-1, so all 4 turns applied)

assertions.then: after one Control+z, the zoom in the store is 1 again
assertions.actual: zoom 1, cx 0.5, cy 0.5; the photo stays in the cell

assertions.then: the slider min attribute is about 0.168, not 1
assertions.actual: 0.1683168316831683, equal to the limit worked out from the brief's rule with cellRects

assertions.then: the slider max attribute is 8
the whole photo shows, with background bands at the left and the right
assertions.actual: after a mouse drag of the thumb past the left end: zoom 0.16832, img 0.4158..0.5841 x 0.25..0.75, bands on all four sides hit the cell

assertions.then: the img height is half of the cell height, within 2 %
assertions.actual: hFrac = 0.5000

assertions.then: given: an iPhone 13 viewport with touch emulation
assertions.actual: Chromium with CDP device metrics 390x664, DPR 3, mobile, touch (maxTouchPoints 5, pointer: coarse), iPhone UA; page reloaded under the emulation

assertions.then: the zoom in the store goes under 1
assertions.actual: touch drag of the thumb (CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent) to the left end: zoom 1 -> 0.16832, slider value 0.168316831683168

assertions.then: the photo shows whole, with background bands at the left and the right
assertions.actual: img 0.4158..0.5841 x 0.25..0.75 of the 390x197 cell, hFrac 0.5, both bands hit the cell, visible background rgb(244, 239, 230)

assertions.then: after the movement, the zoom is under 1
assertions.actual: one mouse drag of the thumb from 1, 1 px per move: 12 input events, 12 distinct zooms in the store (0.9307, 0.8614, 0.7921, ...), end zoom 0.16832

assertions.then: after one undo, the zoom is 1 again
assertions.actual: one click on the undo button: zoom 1, cx 0.5, cy 0.5. A first, coarser drag on another page reached the limit at its first sample and also undid to 1 in one step; it was driven again because a one-event drag cannot show partial undo

assertions.then: the zoom in the store is 1
assertions.actual: cell-1-0 empty before; after a mouse drag of photo-port-1.jpg onto it: photoId set, crop { cx 0.5, cy 0.5, zoom 1 }

assertions.then: the img covers the cell, and no band of background shows
assertions.actual: img left 0, right 1, top -0.985, bottom 1.985

assertions.then: given: land-1.jpg on row3, zoomed out to the lower limit with the zoom slider, dragged to the left edge in crop mode, then Escape
assertions.actual: slider min 0.21678, zoom 0.21678, img wFrac 0.5; after the crop drag left 0, right 0.5; Escape ended crop mode and gutter-0 showed

assertions.then: after each drag, the img box is inside the cell box
assertions.actual: 14 samples (during and after both gutter drags): 0 outside. Cell 0.7x: img 0..0.714 x 0.392..0.608; cell 1.5x: img 0..0.49998 x 0.337..0.663

assertions.then: after the drag to the right, the img width is half of the cell width, within 2 %
assertions.actual: wFrac 0.49998 with the cell at 1.5x its first width

assertions.then: the zoom in the store is exactly 1
assertions.actual: from zoom 0.16832, slider fill('1'): zoom === 1 (strict), slider value '1'. A 0.1 step from the minimum would give 0.96832 or 1.06832

assertions.then: the img covers the cell with no band
assertions.actual: img left 0, right 1, top -0.985, bottom 1.985; no band
